targets.title: Mental fatigue impairs physical performance in humans.
targets.evidence_quote: Therefore, we consider pertinent to replicate Marcora et al.’s (2009) original study to investigate the reliability of their findings.
targets.outcome_quote: Our results are in contrast with those of Marcora et al. (2009) and add to the growing number of studies failing to find any effects of mental fatigue on physical performance (Filipas et al., 2018; Silva-Cavalcante et al., 2018).
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly contrast their results with the target and characterize their study as failing to find the physical-performance effect. They manipulated subjective fatigue successfully. Cautions about small effects and other conditions do not declare this attempt uninformative.
